say:0:1122401001:0.text: Magister, Silverbeak said that all preparations are complete. He's just waiting for us to go over and collect the nets!
say:0:1122401001:0.source_cn: 主人，银喙说所有准备都完成了，就等我们过去收网！
say:0:1122401001:0.male: Magister, Silverbeak said that all preparations are complete. He's just waiting for us to go over and collect the nets!
say:0:1122401001:0.female: Magister, Silverbeak said that all preparations are complete. He's just waiting for us to go over and collect the nets!

say:1:1122401002:0.text: Chippy's been waiting for this moment forever! Let's go right now!
say:1:1122401002:0.source_cn: 满满已经迫不及待了，我们赶快过去吧！

say:2:1122403001:1.text: We trusted you, Silverbeak! And what do we get for it?!
say:2:1122403001:1.source_cn: 银喙，我们以前那么信任你，结果你是怎么对我们的？！

say:3:1122403002:1.text: Always giving us the toughest jobs! In the end, you end up with our hard-earned cash! How come you're the only one who gets to live the easy life?!
say:3:1122403002:1.source_cn: 每次都把最危险最累的事甩给兄弟，最后还卷走我们的辛苦钱...

say:4:1122403003:1.text: That's bullcrap, and you know it! I've never shortchanged you!
say:4:1122403003:1.source_cn: 少胡说八道！我没卷走你们的钱！

say:5:1122403004:1.text: You guys didn't believe me in the beginning! And now you're acting like a bunch of mudscrapers!
say:5:1122403004:1.source_cn: 你们当初就不相信我，直到现在，还是这副德行！

say:6:1122403005:1.text: Hmph! No matter what job we do or what bounty we bring back, you always get a cut!
say:6:1122403005:1.source_cn: 哼，不管我们完成了什么委托，只要拿回酬金来，你就一定要...

say:7:1122403006:1.text: And that's not all! I see that chest with our hard-earned money over there! I bet you took all our money, didn't you?!
say:7:1122403006:1.source_cn: 这也就算了！但是放在箱子里的那些血汗钱，不也都是被你拿...

say:10:1122403007:1.text: Stop lying, you dirty goat-kisser! I've worked with Silverbeak for a long time, and never once did I see him take any of my money!
say:10:1122403007:1.source_cn: ——放屁！我和银喙结伴这么久，从没见他拿过我的钱！

say:11:1122403008:1.text: You're the only dumb lummox here! If he wanted to steal your money, did you think he'd do it in front of you?!
say:11:1122403008:1.source_cn: 蠢货！他要是想拿又怎么可能被你发现！

say:12:1122403009:1.text: When I came in just now, he was counting our money! If I hadn't stopped him, he would've run away with everything!
say:12:1122403009:1.source_cn: 刚才我来的时候，他就在数钱！要不是被我拦下，他早就卷钱...

choice_prompt:13:1122403009.text: When I came in just now, he was counting our money! If I hadn't stopped him, he would've run away with everything!
choice_prompt:13:1122403009.source_cn: 刚才我来的时候，他就在数钱！要不是被我拦下，他早就卷钱跑路了！

say:14:1122403010:1.text: Yeah, that's right! You and Silverbeak had a falling out years ago, and you're just now coming to collect some debt he owes. Who'd believe that?!
say:14:1122403010:1.source_cn: 说得没错！你和银喙好几年前就翻脸了，现在才来讨债，谁信啊！

say:15:1122403013:1.text: Yeah, it's been years. I didn't care, so I didn't pursue it.
say:15:1122403013:1.source_cn: 是，都过去这么多年了，我本来不想追究。

say:16:1122403014:1.text: But then he paid off Albert's debt, so it's high time to pay us what he owes!
say:16:1122403014:1.source_cn: 可银喙还了艾伯特的帐，也该还上欠我们的了！

say:19:1122403012:1.text: They had a falling out with Silverbeak years ago, and they're just now coming to collect some debt he owes?! You're lying through your teeth!
say:19:1122403012:1.source_cn: 他们和银喙好几年前就翻脸了，现在才来讨债，肯定是假的！

say:2:1122405001:1.text: They're all mad at you, Silverbeak!

say:3:1122405002:1.text: ... They said you were going to run away with the money. Is that true?
say:3:1122405002:1.source_cn: ……他们说你准备卷钱跑路，是真的吗？

say:4:1122405003:1.text: Are you doubting me too, Wildclaw?
say:4:1122405003:1.source_cn: 连你也要怀疑我吗？！烈爪！

say:5:1122405004:1.text: It's not that I want to doubt you. But since the start of this camp, several groups of people have come for the same reason!
say:5:1122405004:1.source_cn: 不是我想怀疑你！可是自从建立了基地，这样的人来了好几拨！

say:6:1122405005:1.text: Grayhorn left, and just now, you were even counting money! I demand an explanation!
say:6:1122405005:1.source_cn: 而且你确实抽成了不少钱，老憨也气不过走了！我们需要一个解释！

say:7:1122405006:1.text: Alright... I admit I was counting our money when they showed up.
say:7:1122405006:1.source_cn: ……好吧。我承认，他们来的时候，我是在清点基地里的钱。

say:8:1122405007:1.text: But that's because I've ordered a shipment that needs to be delivered soon. I was getting the payment ready!
say:8:1122405007:1.source_cn: 但那是因为我订了一批货，马上就要送来了，我得准备好货款！

say:9:1122405008:1.text: I'm responsible for ordering all the guns, gunpowder, and supplies for the camp. As for what those sand-eaters were saying, that's pure horse crap! I don't owe them anything!
say:9:1122405008:1.source_cn: 基地里的枪支、火药、物资，全部都是我负责订购的。至于那...

say:10:1122405009:1.text: They're the ones who were racking up debts everywhere. Some merchants with their thugs came to my door and tried to shake me down because of them!
say:10:1122405009:1.source_cn: 他们在外面赊了那么多账，是那些商人带着打手找上门，硬生...

say:11:1122405010:1.text: I left so the heat could die down a bit, but when I came back, they were here looking at me like they were going to eat me alive. They were yelling and screaming, claiming that I stole their money! I'm the innocent one here!
say:11:1122405010:1.source_cn: 我不过出去避避风头，结果回来就看见他们一副要生吞活剥了...

say:12:1122405011:1.text: Then why did you give Albert money?
say:12:1122405011:1.source_cn: 那你为什么要给艾伯特钱？

say:13:1122405012:1.text: He really did lend me money before. I gave him a little bit of interest and put things to rest.
say:13:1122405012:1.source_cn: 他以前确实借过我钱。我多给了一些，算是利息，也是息事宁人。

say:17:1122405016:1.text: Well... I'll believe you for now.

say:18:1122405017:1.text: Alright, it's time for us to clear out the bandits and recover the caravan's goods.
say:18:1122405017:1.source_cn: 很好。我们该开始准备清除盗匪，找回商队货物的事了。

say:19:1122405018:1.text: Wildclaw has already confirmed the location of the bandit camp, as well as their security detail.
say:19:1122405018:1.source_cn: 烈爪已经确认了盗匪营地的位置，还有他们内部的守卫情况。

say:20:1122405019:1.text: According to Wildclaw's observations, now is the time when the guards are the most lax. You two need to seize this moment and go over there right this minute.
say:20:1122405019:1.source_cn: 按照规律，现在就是他们守卫最松懈的时候。你们两个抓紧时...

choice_prompt:21:1122405019.text: According to Wildclaw's observations, now is the time when the guards are the most lax. You two need to seize this moment and go over there right this minute.
choice_prompt:21:1122405019.source_cn: 按照规律，现在就是他们守卫最松懈的时候。你们两个抓紧时间，赶快过去。

say:22:1122405020:1.text: Like I said before, the shipment hasn't arrived yet. I have to wait here for the courier.
say:22:1122405020:1.source_cn: 我说了，我订的货还没到，得在这里等接线人。

say:23:1122405021:1.text: Rest assured, that shipment will make completing bounties twice as easy for us.
say:23:1122405021:1.source_cn: 放心，那批货能让我们的任务——事半功倍。

say:25:1122405015:1.text: It's not something I can tell you right now, but I guarantee that this shipment will definitely be useful in the future.
say:25:1122405015:1.source_cn: 很多东西，不方便全都告诉你们，以后肯定能用上。

choice:15:1:2.text: Tell me about the shipment, Silverbeak.
choice:15:1:2.male: Tell me about the shipment, Silverbeak.
choice:15:1:2.female: Tell me about the shipment, Silverbeak.

say:0:1122406001:0.text: Can we really trust Silverbeak? Chippy feels uneasy...
say:0:1122406001:0.source_cn: 银喙真的没问题吗？满满感觉好不安……

say:2:1122406003:0.text: I mean, after all this time, he hasn't done me wrong yet. I trust him.
say:2:1122406003:0.source_cn: 不管怎么说，这么久以来，他没有害过我。我相信他。

say:0:1122407001:0.source_cn: 就是这里了，盗匪的营地。

say:1:1122407002:0.text: There are only a few guards on duty. Let's sneak past them.
say:1:1122407002:0.source_cn: 现在这时间只有几个守卫在值班。我们绕过他们，悄悄潜进去吧。

say:1:1122410001:1.text: Albert... I never thought he would end up working with the bandits.
say:1:1122410001:1.source_cn: 艾伯特……没想到他会走到今天这个地步。

choice_prompt:2:1122410001.text: Albert... I never thought he would end up working with the bandits.
choice_prompt:2:1122410001.source_cn: 艾伯特……没想到他会走到今天这个地步。

say:3:1122410004:1.text: The camp I asked you to go to last time is where he and I often went to get information.
say:3:1122410004:1.source_cn: 上次让你去的那个营地，就是我和他经常去打听消息的地方。
say:3:1122410004:1.male: The camp I asked you to go to last time is where he and I often went to get information.
say:3:1122410004:1.female: The camp I asked you to go to last time is where he and I often went to get information.

say:4:1122410005:1.text: After you told me that there were bounty hunters being paid by bandits, I guessed that he may have been one of them.
say:4:1122410005:1.source_cn: 在你告诉我，有赏金猎人被盗匪收买之后，我就猜到，那其中...
say:4:1122410005:1.male: After you told me that there were bounty hunters being paid by bandits, I guessed that he may have been one of them.
say:4:1122410005:1.female: After you told me that there were bounty hunters being paid by bandits, I had an inkling that he may have been one of them.

say:5:1122410006:1.text: I didn't want to believe he'd actually work with them though. It's still hard to believe...
say:5:1122410006:1.source_cn: 但我从来没想过，他真的会沦落到与盗匪为伍的境地。真是世...

choice_prompt:6:1122410006.text: I didn't want to believe he'd actually work with them though. It's still hard to believe...
choice_prompt:6:1122410006.source_cn: 但我从来没想过，他真的会沦落到与盗匪为伍的境地。真是世事无常……

say:7:1122410007:1.text: Alright, enough of this depressing topic.

say:8:1122410008:1.text: Let's get the goods and find the Buckthorn Caravan leader. It's time to get paid.
say:8:1122410008:1.source_cn: 拿上货物，我们去找红沙棘领赏金。

choice:6:0:1.text: Maybe he was always like this.
choice:6:0:1.male: Maybe he was always like this.
choice:6:0:1.female: Maybe he was always like this.

say:10:1122410002:1.text: ... When we first came to the Eroded Enclave, we were just two young men who couldn't get along with each other.
say:10:1122410002:1.source_cn: 哼，刚来风蚀飞地的时候，我们还只是两个不对付的毛头小子。

say:11:1122410003:1.text: But we worked on a job together. He was good at fighting, and I was good at scouting.
say:11:1122410003:1.source_cn: 不过为了赏金，我们还是合作了。他战斗力出众，我擅长探查情报。

choice:2:1:2.text: It seems that you were close before.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 看来你们以前感情不错
choice:2:1:2.male: It seems that you were close before.
choice:2:1:2.female: It seems that you were close before.

say:0:1122411001:0.text: Silverbeak, why didn't you tell us you bought explosives?
say:0:1122411001:0.source_cn: 银喙，你怎么不告诉我们你订的东西是炸药桶？害我们胡思乱...

say:1:1122411002:0.text: The less people know, the better. The plan worked, right?
say:1:1122411002:0.source_cn: 这么机密的计划，肯定是越少人知道越好。

say:2:1122411003:0.text: I didn't want anyone to act out of character.
say:2:1122411003:0.source_cn: 否则，要是被人从咱们的一言一行中察觉出了异样，我可就白...

say:1:1122412001:1.text: Dura above! You actually found my goods!
say:1:1122412001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……你们真的找回了我的货物！

say:2:1122412002:1.text: No need to act all surprised! Just check if everything's there. I want to get paid.
say:2:1122412002:1.source_cn: 别光顾着痛哭流涕了，赶紧清点一下，我们还等着领赏金呢。

say:3:1122412003:1.text: Alright, not so fast. Let me take a look first...
say:3:1122412003:1.source_cn: 哎呀，别急，让我仔细点点……

say:4:1122412004:1.text: Hmm... it's less than my original shipment. It's not a huge loss, but still...
say:4:1122412004:1.source_cn: 这……这比丢失之前，少了不少好东西啊！虽然整体损失不大...

say:5:1122412005:1.text: This shipment was in the hands of the bandits for a long time. What do you expect?
say:5:1122412005:1.source_cn: 这批货在盗匪手里待了这么久，不缺斤少两才怪。

say:6:1122412006:1.text: I'll say this right now. If our reward is even a single copper less than what your bounty stated, we're going to have a problem.
say:6:1122412006:1.source_cn: 但我丑话说在前头，赏金可不能有半个金币的折扣。否则，你...

say:7:1122412007:1.text: Hey, I didn't mean like that! Whatever was stated on the bounty is what you're going to get.
say:7:1122412007:1.source_cn: ——别别别！我没这意思！悬赏令上说的赏金，绝对不会少了...

say:11:1122412009:1.text: For the sake of our base... and so you all can have a bigger cut.
say:11:1122412009:1.source_cn: 为了基地的建设——也为了让你们多挣点酬金。

say:12:1122412010:1.text: I mean she set the reward herself, so I'm not going to feel sorry for her.
say:12:1122412010:1.source_cn: 更何况，是他自己定的悬赏金额，我可不会替他心疼。

say:14:1122412011:1.text: Here you go! Ten thousand gold!
say:14:1122412011:1.source_cn: 给。你们检查吧，一万枚金币！

say:15:1122412012:1.text: Well, that definitely feels like ten thousand gold. Much obliged.

say:17:1122412013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Wildclaw, let's divvy up our cuts!
say:17:1122412013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Wildclaw, let's divvy up our cuts!
say:17:1122412013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Wildclaw, let's divvy up our cuts!

choice:10:1:2.text: Why are you being so aggressive?
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 怎么突然变得咄咄逼人了
choice:10:1:2.male: Why are you being so aggressive?
choice:10:1:2.female: Why are you being so aggressive?

say:1:1122413001:1.text: Here's your share. After doing all these jobs, the pay ain't that bad, right?
say:1:1122413001:1.source_cn: 拿好你的酬金。做了这么多任务，回报总归还算丰厚吧。
say:1:1122413001:1.male: Here's your share. After doing all these jobs, the pay ain't that bad, right?
say:1:1122413001:1.female: Here's your share. After doing all these jobs, the pay ain't that bad, right?

say:2:1122413002:1.text: By the way, congratulations, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That was the last lesson in becoming a bounty hunter.
say:2:1122413002:1.male: By the way, congratulations, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That was the last lesson in becoming a bounty hunter.
say:2:1122413002:1.female: By the way, congratulations, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That was the last lesson in becoming a bounty hunter.

choice_prompt:3:1122413002.text: By the way, congratulations, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That was the last lesson in becoming a bounty hunter.
choice_prompt:3:1122413002.source_cn: 顺便也要恭喜你，<style=stress><player_name></style>，完成了赏金猎人的最后一课。
choice_prompt:3:1122413002.male: By the way, congratulations, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That was the last lesson in becoming a bounty hunter.
choice_prompt:3:1122413002.female: By the way, congratulations, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. That was the last lesson in becoming a bounty hunter.

say:4:1122413003:1.text: Ha! It actually began ages ago, the first day this camp was being built.
say:4:1122413003:1.source_cn: 哈，瞧瞧我瞒得多好！从建立基地的第一天，这堂课就开始了。

say:5:1122413004:1.text: This last lesson was all about trust.

say:7:1122413005:1.text: Like how you didn't tell <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Wildclaw about the explosives.

say:8:1122413006:1.text: Well, yeah, but there's more to it than that.

say:10:1122413007:1.text: Splitting the reward money after a job is also a sign of your trust.
say:10:1122413007:1.source_cn: 从你们完成委托后拿到的酬金里抽成，也是对你们信任的考验。

say:11:1122413008:1.text: Bounty hunters value money. There's no better way to test someone's trust than with money.
say:11:1122413008:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人看重钱财，用钱来考验信任，最合适不过了！

say:12:1122413009:1.text: Maulers like Grayhorn always think that I'm somehow cheating them out of their coin, no matter how much I explain what I'm doing.
say:12:1122413009:1.source_cn: 像老憨那样的人，他们总是认为抽成的钱被我独吞了，不管我...

say:13:1122413010:1.text: Thankfully, you and Wildclaw didn't let me down.
say:13:1122413010:1.source_cn: 不过还好，你和烈爪没辜负我的信任。
say:13:1122413010:1.male: Thankfully, you and Wildclaw didn't let me down.
say:13:1122413010:1.female: Thankfully, you and Wildclaw didn't let me down.

choice_prompt:14:1122413010.text: Thankfully, you and Wildclaw didn't let me down.
choice_prompt:14:1122413010.source_cn: 不过还好，你和烈爪没辜负我的信任。
choice_prompt:14:1122413010.male: Thankfully, you and Wildclaw didn't let me down.
choice_prompt:14:1122413010.female: Thankfully, you and Wildclaw didn't let me down.

say:15:1122413011:1.text: That means you have a good eye.

say:16:1122413014:1.text: So, I just wanted to thank you for believing me.
say:16:1122413014:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，谢谢你们愿意相信我。

choice_prompt:17:1122413014.text: So, I just wanted to thank you for believing me.
choice_prompt:17:1122413014.source_cn: 不管怎么样，谢谢你们愿意相信我。

say:18:1122413016:1.text: Also, this job went perfectly, and you mastered all the skills I taught you.
say:18:1122413016:1.source_cn: 另外，这次任务完成得很不错。我教给你的四门技能，你都掌...
say:18:1122413016:1.male: Also, this job went perfectly, and you mastered all the skills I taught you.
say:18:1122413016:1.female: Also, this job went perfectly, and you mastered all the skills I taught you.

say:19:1122413017:1.text: Disguising and camouflaging yourself, gathering intel, working with fellow bounty hunters, and getting the job done efficiently.
say:19:1122413017:1.source_cn: 既能用伪装隐藏自己，打探情报；又能和同伴合作，高效地清...
say:19:1122413017:1.male: Disguising and camouflaging yourself, gathering intel, working with fellow bounty hunters, and getting the job done efficiently.
say:19:1122413017:1.female: Disguising and camouflaging yourself, gathering intel, working with fellow bounty hunters, and getting the job done efficiently.

say:20:1122413018:1.text: You're already a full-blown bounty hunter!
say:20:1122413018:1.source_cn: ——你已经是一名出色的赏金猎人了！
say:20:1122413018:1.male: You're already a full-blown bounty hunter!
say:20:1122413018:1.female: You're already a full-blown bounty hunter!

say:22:1122413015:1.text: Ha! It looks like you've been spending too much time with us. You even sound like a Mauler.
say:22:1122413015:1.source_cn: 呵。感觉你和我们在一起待久了，说话也变得很不客气啊。
say:22:1122413015:1.male: Ha! It looks like you've been spending too much time with us. You even sound like a Mauler.
say:22:1122413015:1.female: Ha! It looks like you've been spending too much time with us. You even sound like a Mauler.

choice:17:1:2.text: You sound like a soft-skinned human.
choice:17:1:2.male: You sound like a soft-skinned human.
choice:17:1:2.female: You sound like a soft-skinned human.

choice:14:0:1.text: I always try to trust people.
choice:14:0:1.male: I always try to trust people.
choice:14:0:1.female: I always try to trust people.

say:23:1122413012:1.text: You're not one of those goat-kissing bounty hunters who love money more than their lives. That's why I brought you in.
say:23:1122413012:1.source_cn: 你可不是那些混账赏金猎人，恨不得把钱看得比命还重要。这...
say:23:1122413012:1.male: You're not one of those goat-kissing bounty hunters who love money more than their lives. That's why I brought you in.
